info.author: xcode
info.comment: Flat vector splash illustration, tall portrait composition. A clean civic office desk from above: white blotter, navy folder, blue pen aligned horizontally, a simple barcode strip, and a gray coffee cup. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, limited palette navy #1B3A6B, bright blue #2F6FED, cool gray #8A93A0, white #FFFFFF, light gray #E6EBF2. No text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, generous negative space, crisp edges.
